description: Creates an invoice and returns pay_url — a hosted payment page where the payer picks a coin and pays; the amount is credited to your balance in USDT minus the fee. Give amount_usd, or price_amount + price_currency (converted at get_fiat_rates). Use environment "test" to try the whole flow without real money: a test invoice turns paid by itself about 10 seconds after a coin is selected (on its page or with select_invoice_payment_method); the real balance does not change. Then follow the status with get_invoice or webhooks (invoice.paid). To get a deposit address right away instead of a page, pass asset_id (and lock_method true), or call select_invoice_payment_method.

amount_usd.description: Invoice amount in USD. Either this or price_amount + price_currency.

asset_id.description: Preselect the coin the payer pays with (Public asset code from list_assets (its asset_id field), e.g. "usdt" (USDT TRC20), "btc", "eth", "xmr", "usdc_eth".)

cancel_url.description: Where the payer returns on cancel.

description.description: What is paid for; shown to the payer.

environment.description: "test" — no real money: paid by itself ~10 s after a coin is selected, balance unchanged.

external_id.description: Your own reference (order id); unique per account.

fee_on.description: Who pays the service fee: you (default) or the payer on top of the amount.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. The same key returns the same result instead of a duplicate (safe retries); generated when omitted.

lock_method.description: true — the payer cannot change asset_id (requires asset_id).

success_url.description: Where the payer returns after paying.

name: create_invoice
title: Create an invoice (receive crypto)
